title: Live long
objectives: state age and longevity milestones using numbers 1-100

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for Live long.
Welcome to today's lesson: Live long! Today we will practice how to state age and longevity milestones using numbers 1-100.

elements.content: state age and longevity milestones using numbers 1-100; describe healthy living habits

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: age, year, old, healthy, live, life

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

elements.content: How old is the grandfather in the reading passage?

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript
teacherNotes.content: She is ninety years old and very active. She eats healthy food every day.

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
My grandfather is eighty years old. He is very healthy and lives a happy life.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: Talk about healthy habits that help people live a long, active life.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Review key corrections and confirm homework task.
Great work today! Remember to review target words in your mobile app before our next class.

elements.content: Today you practiced: state age and longevity milestones using numbers 1-100, describe healthy living habits.
